parties: Abeyasinghe Arachchige Asoka v. R.P.R. Rajapaksha, Commissioner General of Land & Others Abeyasinghe Arachchige Asoka v. R.P.R. Rajapaksha, Commissioner General of Land & Others View More
keywords: Judicial review – State land grant – Nominated successor – Petitioner named as successor to father’s grant – Divisional Secretary subsequently creating joint ownership with rival claimant – Disputed facts concerning alleged consent – Whether oral evidence required – Court distinguishing factual dispute from pure question of statutory legality – Land Development Ordinance did not authorize creation of co-ownership – Administrative action ultra vires – Certiorari issued quashing joint-ownership decision – Mandamus issued directing authorities to endorse petitioner’s name on grant or issue fresh grant. Vijith K. Malalgoda PC J. agreed.
legistation: Constitution – Article 140; Land Development Ordinance – sections 48, 72 and 87.
